navigation_record_fields.source: actions.getRecordInfo1 reads row fields by refer_type at owner.data_model_index(default0), including bizz_sid,menu_sid,data_sid,record_sid,hid,data_dt,data_no,record_seq_no. actions.movePage1 passes those distinct fields to IInventoryInputPage navigation param.
navigation_record_fields.boundary: This identifies actual field names used for generic input navigation. It does not prove which fields current aggregate summary rows contain, their lifetime/uniqueness, or equality to own doc.id/lineId. No navigation or edit was executed.

sequence_vs_opaque_ID.source: Original navigation keeps data_sid,record_sid and record_seq_no as separate parameters. widget$$initialize_focus consumes record_seq_no or legacy FocusRowNumber as focus_row_no and sets data_model_index=focus_row_no-1.
sequence_vs_opaque_ID.boundary: record_seq_no has a positional-focus use. Source does not prove it immutable or interchangeable with record_sid or an own stable lineId.

generic_comparison_identity.source: createComparisonValueExtractor returns data_dt$data_no for $$date_no; data_dt$data_no$record_seq_no for $$date_record_seq_no; code for $$code.
generic_comparison_identity.explicit_exclusion: This is comparison-period matching configuration only. It is not proof of current ordinary 전표별/라인별 GROUPBY, canonical stable identity or display format, and is not used to assert original-axis datatype binding.

drilldown_filter_boundary.source: summary_line and summary_slip lookup to date search. When target search property is $$date_range_condition, generateAggregateSearchDataModel reads clicked row data_dt_no.data_dt and calls convertToDateByDateReferType. Neither summary_line nor summary_slip has a specialized conversion case, so default creates same-date from/to.
drilldown_filter_boundary.row_scope_limit: This helper itself does not write a data_no,record_seq_no,data_sid or record_sid filter for these refer types. Other actions/defaults/context may narrow scope; current binding unknown. Do not claim this source opens exactly one original document/row.
drilldown_filter_boundary.priority_limit: Among date-typed selected conditions, StandardUserAction priority ranks summary_line before summary_slip before day/week/month/quarter/half/year. This priority concerns drilldown condition selection, not ordinary aggregate grouping.
drilldown_filter_boundary.receiver: Common StandardUserAction resets aggregate towards default/fixed line details_target or removes it for certain submenus, overlays generated search filters, opens a popup and configures header search. This is aggregate-result drilldown, not the row edit/navigation path above.

ordinary_group_metadata_consumer.selection: Compatible selector returns template_item.prop_id,label/refer_type/data_type/item_meaning_id. Concrete current values absent.
ordinary_group_metadata_consumer.layout: processFreeAggregateCondition carries selected prop and dynamic DMC attributes/label into layout; this does not define a doc/line stable ID projection.
ordinary_group_metadata_consumer.query: Free normalizer preserves selected condition objects and rebuilds groups from unique selected nonempty prop_id. Fixed+details_target=line branch clears groups. Free summary_line is not locally special-cased by that groups builder.
ordinary_group_metadata_consumer.server_boundary: No captured ordinary server GROUPBY/projection or current template property definition proves a document/line identity formula.

line_only_mode_flag.source: inventory.checkAggregate returns false for fixed+details_target=line. For free, collects nonempty prop IDs, resolves grid_dmc.getPropIdByReferType(summary_line), and returns false if this is the sole unique selected ID. Otherwise true.
line_only_mode_flag.order_boundary: SelectInventoryStatusProgram calls the query using transformed conditions/sorts/groups first, then computes is_aggregate from search/grid DMC after response. Thus this client mode flag is not proof of clearing free-line request.groups, changing server grouping or stable identity.

own_independent_policy_assessment.provided_model_facts: Parent supplies own document id/date and stable lineId. Worker did not execute/read business records.
own_independent_policy_assessment.feasibility: Use own doc.id for document buckets and own doc.id+stable lineId for line buckets. Own doc.date and current display line number can be presentation fields.
own_independent_policy_assessment.legacy_boundary: A separate tagged fallback for legacy position-derived rows is an own compatibility policy; do not describe it as original record_sid/record_seq_no equivalence or universal stable identity.
own_independent_policy_assessment.display_boundary: Current-order line number is display only; it must not replace stable line identity. Original doc-number/date/row formatting remains unknown until masked UI observation.
own_independent_policy_assessment.equivalence_boundary: Own identifiers, stable key semantics and local numeric aggregation are independent implementation policies. Original SID/code/display/GROUPBY/server totals remain unknown.
